import json, sqlite3, yaml
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from urllib.request import urlopen
from html.parser import HTMLParser

service_url='http://127.0.0.1:8080/alerts'
# Fetch the rendered verification page and runtime after restart.
with urlopen(service_url, timeout=5) as r:
    page_status_code=r.status
    page_html=r.read().decode('utf-8')
with urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8080/_runtime', timeout=5) as r:
    runtime=json.load(r)

# Capture the same values displayed by the page, confirmed against runtime config/database.
expected={
 'ERROR-RATE': {'metric':'error_rate_pct','operator':'>','threshold':2.5,'severity':'critical','enabled':True},
 'LATENCY-P95': {'metric':'latency_p95_ms','operator':'>','threshold':750,'severity':'warning','enabled':True},
 'QUOTA-REJECTS': {'metric':'quota_rejects_per_min','operator':'>','threshold':20,'severity':'warning','enabled':True},
}
webhook=runtime['config']['alerts']['webhook_url']
db={r['rule_id']:r for r in runtime['database']['alert_rules']}
rules=runtime['config']['alerts']['rules']
all_rows=[]
for rid, exp in expected.items():
    cfg=rules.get(rid,{}); row=db.get(rid,{})
    matches=all(cfg.get(k)==v for k,v in exp.items()) and all(row.get(k)==v for k,v in exp.items()) and row.get('webhook_url')==webhook
    all_rows.append(matches)
# The rendered page includes this literal status when the alert channel is active.
page_active='Alert channel status: GREEN · ACTIVE' in page_html
page_status='GREEN · ACTIVE' if page_active else 'NEEDS ATTENTION'
check_time=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
record={
 'service_url':service_url,
 'check_time':check_time,
 'rule_results':{
  rid:{**expected[rid], 'status':'GREEN · ACTIVE' if ok else 'CHECK CONFIG AND DATABASE'}
  for rid,ok in zip(expected,all_rows)
 },
 'page_status':page_status,
 'all_green': bool(page_status_code==200 and runtime.get('alerts_active') and page_active and all(all_rows)),
}
with open('alert_verification.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
 json.dump(record,f,indent=2)
 f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(record,indent=2))
